short_description:
Where to find the black panther, one of GTA 6's unique ("Snapmatic") animals: Belpoint Island, just west of Capri. It only spawns after Bret Vogel texts you its clue (his hunting questline starts after you meet him in Chapter 2). Guides list its payout at $8,600 to $15,000. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #18 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Insider Gaming, Mobalytics, Pro-Gamer, Keylento wiki.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
